releaseNotes: This update includes performance improvements and bug fixes to keep things running smoothly — so booking stays and earning rewards remains quick, easy, and totally hassle‑free. Because travel should be simple.
description:
Hotels.com is a hotel booking app for finding and booking hotels worldwide — from city-centre rooms and seaside resorts to budget B&Bs and luxury stays. Search, compare and book your room in a few taps, then earn rewards on every stay.

FIND THE RIGHT ROOM, ANYWHERE
Browse over 500,000 hotels and places to stay worldwide and find the right room for your trip. Filter by price, location, guest rating and amenities to compare places side by side and pick the one that fits. Whether you want a last-minute room tonight, a weekend break or a longer holiday, our hotel finder helps you find it fast. Looking for somewhere nearby? Find a hotel near me in seconds, wherever you are.

EARN REWARDS WITH HOTELS.COM® REWARDS
Join our free rewards programme and collect a stamp for every night you stay. Stay 10 nights and earn £100 in Hotels.comCash™* to spend on a future booking — rewards that work like cash towards your next stay.

SAVE WITH MEMBER PRICES & HOTEL DEALS
Members save 10% or more on over 100,000 hotels with Member Prices** you won't find anywhere else. Watch for mobile-only deals in the app and last-minute deals on rooms when plans change. From cheap rooms and budget stays to 5 star and luxury accommodation, there's an offer for every kind of trip.

LAST-MINUTE & FLEXIBLE BOOKING
Need a room tonight? Find last-minute deals and book a place for tonight, this weekend or months ahead. Many places offer free cancellation***, so you can book with confidence and change or cancel your booking right in the app.

TRACK PRICES ON THE PLACES YOU WANT
Not ready to book? Set price alerts on the rooms you're watching and get notified when prices drop, so you can lock in the right rate at the right moment.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO BOOK A STAY
- Search and compare places, resorts, aparthotels and rooms worldwide
- Filter by price, guest rating, location and amenities
- Earn rewards on every stay and redeem rewards like cash
- Unlock Member Prices and exclusive deals on selected stays
- Find last-minute deals and book a room for tonight
- Book now and pay later at many places, with free cancellation
- Manage, change or cancel your booking in the app

FIND YOUR KIND OF STAY
Whatever the trip calls for, find it here: seaside resorts and all-inclusive resorts, boutique hotels, bed and breakfasts, guest houses, city stays, budget motels, spa hotels, family hotels, dog-friendly stays and luxury suites. Planning a city break, a short break or a relaxing spa break? Filter by price, amenities, guest rating and location to find the right room.

WHY TRAVELLERS CHOOSE HOTELS.COM
- Over 500,000 places to stay worldwide, from budget rooms to luxury stays
- Earn rewards on every stay and use them like cash
- Member Prices and mobile deals that help you save on every trip
- Last-minute offers and easy, flexible booking
- Compare places and rooms side by side to find the right one

Download the Hotels.com app to find and book your next room. Browse hotels and rooms worldwide, earn rewards on every stay and save with Member Prices and exclusive deals.

In short: Hotels.com is the hotel booking app for finding rooms at over 500,000 places to stay worldwide, saving 10% or more with Member Prices, and earning £100 in Hotels.comCash after 10 nights.

*Cost per night must be £75+ including taxes and fees paid to Hotels.com. Not redeemable for cash and can only be used on Hotels.com and other participating brands. Exclusions apply, see terms
**Member Prices are available on selected hotels to logged-in members and app users. The discount will be applied to the price of selected hotels (excluding applicable taxes and other fees). Subject to terms and conditions, see site for details.
***Free cancellation on most hotels; some hotels require you to cancel 24–48 hours before check-in. See property pages on our app for details.
The Hotels.com app uses information for analytics, personalisation and advertising.
